Name: DE-CreditNotesItems
Description: Extracts information about client credit notes items.
Statement:
select	ccn.Oid as ClientCreditNoteId,
        ccn.Name as ClientCreditNote,
        ccn.Name as ClientCreditNoteNumber,
        ccni.Oid as ClientCreditNoteItemId,
        concat(ccn.Name, ' - ', ccni.[Order]) as ClientCreditNoteItem,
        ccni.ValueWithoutVat,
		ccni.VatValue,
		ccni.ValueWithVat,
		ccni.UnitPrice,
		ccni.Discount,
		ccni.Description,
		ccni.[Order],
		ccni.Quantity,
        rr.Oid as ReversalReasonId,
        rr.Name as ReversalReasonName,
        vat.Oid as VatId,
        vat.Name as VatName,
        vat.Percentage as VatPercentage
from	ClientCreditNoteItem ccni
            join Article art on art.Oid = ccni.Article
            join ClientCreditNote ccn on ccni.ClientCreditNote = ccn.Oid
            left join Vat vat on ccni.Vat = vat.Oid
            left join ReversalReason rr on ccni.ReversalReason = rr.Oid
